comment: Great professor, structure of course very well organized.
She is a dear, very nice woman. Class can be boring at times and the assignments are the longest papers you will probably work on in Law school.

I adore this woman. She is hilariously awkward, and knows it. Uses this for her own benefit. She is unassuming but was a clerk for the Chief Justice of the S.C. of VA. If you get her, you are so lucky!
